note: QUARANTINED, NOT DELETED (CLAUDE.md §3). Eitan reviewed the Prompts tab on 2026-08-09 and saw that every 'Prompt pack' the CREATORS department published was the same sentence with one word swapped. He was right. These are preserved here verbatim so nothing is lost and so the failure stays inspectable; they are un-published from the app.
why: ROOT CAUSE, verified by reading the code and the data, not inferred: src/excava_creators.py draft() is a Python f-string loop with NO model call anywhere in the module (grep for 'engine' in that file returns zero hits, while src/excava_engines.complete() has existed and been used by the Rooms for weeks). The 'gap' each pack claimed to fill was a word-frequency count: intake_demand_terms is re.findall(r'[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z\-]{4,}') over social post titles minus a six-word stoplist, which is why the terms were 'claude', 'skills', 'agents' — common words, not hub gaps. And _self_test() could not fail: it checks four fields are non-empty, scans a wordlist, and returns link_alive=True when url is empty. Templater -> a test that cannot fail -> auto-publish -> a badge in the app. That is the P4 'real, not display' violation the protocols exist to prevent, shipped as product.

restore: Only Eitan restores these. They are NOT a starting point to edit — the fix is a real writer working against a defined bar (owner_requests.json OR-1), not better f-strings.
